$comment: Schema of the values of the proTES chart: app-values.schema.json of the library chart foca-common 0.2.0 (the version that this release requires, with FOCA 0.17; scripts/check_release_pins.py checks that Chart.yaml and Chart.lock pin it), with the app's key (protes, with extraEnv) and Flower (flower) added; update it with the library chart

not.$comment: Rejects all-zero quantities (Go regular expressions have no lookahead)

tmpSizeLimit.description: Size limit of the emptyDir at /tmp: a positive Kubernetes quantity (e.g., 64Mi) or number of bytes; none if null

not.$comment: Rejects all-zero quantities (Go regular expressions have no lookahead)

size.description: Size of the PersistentVolumeClaim: a positive Kubernetes quantity (e.g., 1Gi)

accessModes.description: Access modes of the PersistentVolumeClaim (writable modes only, as the data is written there); ReadWriteOnce if not set

storageClass.description: Storage class of the PersistentVolumeClaim; the cluster's default class if empty; - disables dynamic provisioning

existingClaim.description: Existing PersistentVolumeClaim to use instead of the component's own

resourcePolicy.description: keep: Helm keeps the component's own PersistentVolumeClaim (and its data) when the release is uninstalled or the claim is removed from it; empty: Helm deletes it

persistence.description: Volume with a component's data: a PersistentVolumeClaim if enabled, otherwise an emptyDir

parentRefs.description: Gateway API parent references (group, kind, namespace, name, sectionName, port), e.g., a Gateway and one of its listeners

image.description: App image repository, optionally with a tag or digest

imagePullPolicy.description: Pull policy of the app image; Always if not set

tag.description: App image tag; defaults to the chart's appVersion

enabled.description: Create an Ingress, for any ingress controller (not with httpRoute.enabled); otherwise an OpenShift Route, if route.enabled, the cluster serves route.openshift.io/v1 and httpRoute is disabled

className.description: Ingress class; the cluster's default class if empty

annotations.description: Annotations of the Ingress, e.g., for the ingress controller (the chart sets none for particular controllers); take precedence over those set by the chart for https, null removes them

enabled.description: Request a certificate from cert-manager and serve HTTPS
Create a Gateway API HTTPRoute attached to parentRefs (not with ingress.enabled)

parentRefs.description: Gateways (or listeners, via sectionName or port) that the HTTPRoute attaches to, e.g., the HTTPS listener of a shared Gateway; required if enabled

filters.description: Filters of the HTTPRoute's rule (HTTPRouteFilter), e.g., an ExtensionRef to a resource of the Gateway implementation for body size or rate limits

enabled.description: Create a second HTTPRoute, attached to httpsRedirect.parentRefs, that redirects HTTP to HTTPS (301)

parentRefs.description: HTTP listeners of the Gateway for the redirect; must not attach to the listeners of httpRoute.parentRefs; required if enabled

enabled.description: Create an OpenShift Route for all paths if neither ingress nor httpRoute is enabled and the cluster serves route.openshift.io/v1; true if not set

annotations.description: Annotations of the OpenShift Route, e.g., for rate limits of the router

enabled.description: Create a NetworkPolicy allowing connections to the app only from ingressFrom

ingressFrom.description: NetworkPolicy peers allowed to connect to the app, e.g., the pods of the ingress controller or Gateway; no defaults, as they depend on the cluster; must not be empty if enabled

podSecurityContext.description: Security context of the pod (runAsUser, runAsGroup and fsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

securityContext.description: Security context of the container (runAsUser and runAsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

preStopSleepSeconds.description: Seconds that the app keeps serving after its pod is deleted (preStop hook); 0 omits the hook

gunicorn.description: Settings of Gunicorn, the WSGI server of the app image (via GUNICORN_CMD_ARGS); omit them if the image does not run Gunicorn

workers.description: Worker processes; each loads the whole app

timeout.description: Seconds after which workers whose main loop does not respond are restarted (slow requests in threads do not count)

gracefulTimeout.description: Seconds that workers get to finish requests on shutdown; the termination grace period is this plus preStopSleepSeconds plus 10 seconds

keepalive.description: Seconds after which idle keep-alive connections are closed (0: no keep-alive); longer than the idle timeout of the proxy's connections to the app

extraArgs.description: Further Gunicorn options (no single quotes); --bind/-b, --preload and --graceful-timeout are rejected

resources.description: Resource requests and limits of the container

app.description: Settings of the app container (under the key of the app chart, e.g., cloudRegistry)

nameOverride.description: Replaces the chart name in resource names and labels; set at installation only

fullnameOverride.description: Replaces the name of the app resources (MongoDB resources get the suffix -mongodb); set at installation only

hostName.description: Public host name of the app (of the Ingress, HTTPRoute or Route)

publicUrl.description: Public URL of the app as clients see it, if not https://<hostName>/ (e.g., with the path prefix of a proxy); sets server.public_url

config.description: App config overriding the base config in the image (merged by FOCA)

max_content_length.description: Size limit of request bodies, in bytes

url.description: Base URL of the TES instance, without /ga4gh/tes/v1

urlSchemes.description: Allowed schemes of url (url_schemes); https only by default

id.description: Identifier of the entry; defaults to the normalized URL

auth.description: Credentials of proTES for the backend

basic.description: Environment variables with the HTTP Basic credentials (auth: basic)

labels.description: Labels of the backends, e.g., {region: eu-north}

url.description: Base URL of the registry's API

urlSchemes.description: Allowed schemes of url (url_schemes); https only by default

id.description: Identifier of the entry; defaults to the normalized URL

auth.description: Credentials of proTES for the discovered backends

labels.description: Labels of the backends, e.g., {region: eu-north}

backends.description: TES backends, in order (custom.tes.backends, with camelCase keys)

plugins.description: Plugins that process new tasks, rendered into the plugins section of the app config with its keys (see deployment/README.md, Configuration); empty values are left out

params.description: Parameters of the plugin, kept as they are

alternatives.description: Plugins with parameters, tried in order

timeout.description: Time limit of each plugin of the step, in seconds

onFailure.description: Whether the request fails (fail, the default) or the step is skipped if all alternatives fail (on_failure)

distribution.description: Distribution (package) that must provide the plugin

config.description: Admin settings of the plugin, kept as they are

clientSelectable.description: Whether clients may choose the plugin in pipelines of their own (client_selectable)

roles.description: Roles that may choose the plugin; any if empty

enabled.description: Whether the plugin keeps its entries in the database (shared by all replicas); if false, each process keeps them in memory

maxEntrySize.description: Maximum size of values, in bytes of compact JSON (max_entry_size)

maxTtl.description: Maximum time to live of entries, in seconds, at most 10 years (max_ttl)

store.description: Settings of the plugin's key-value store (ctx.store), replacing those of config.plugins.defaults.store

available.description: Installed plugins that may be used, by identifier (FOCA's built-in ones always are)

pipeline.description: Steps that process each new task; FOCA's ordered failover if empty

presets.description: Pipelines that clients may choose by name

clientPipelines.description: Whether and how clients may choose pipelines (client_pipelines; off by default)

clientBackends.description: Whether and how clients may choose TES instances (client_backends)

enabled.description: Deploy the bundled MongoDB; if false, set config.db.host (and port) of an external one

image.description: MongoDB image, pinned to a patch version or digest

imagePullPolicy.description: Pull policy of the MongoDB image; Always if not set

existingSecret.description: Secret with the MongoDB credentials (keys username and password, and root-username and root-password for the bundled MongoDB); required if authentication is enabled

enabled.description: Create a NetworkPolicy allowing connections to MongoDB only from the app's pods

podSecurityContext.description: Security context of the pod (runAsUser, runAsGroup and fsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

securityContext.description: Security context of the container (runAsUser and runAsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

enabled.description: Keep MongoDB's data in a PersistentVolumeClaim (also if not set); otherwise in an emptyDir (limited to size, if set), so that the data is lost when its pod is replaced

resourcePolicy.description: keep (also if not set): Helm keeps MongoDB's claim (and the database) when the release is uninstalled or the claim is removed from it, e.g., by disabling persistence (on upgrades, only once a deployed revision has set the annotation); empty: Helm deletes it

volumeSize.description: Deprecated since foca-common 0.2.0 (the setting up to 0.1.0): use persistence.size, which it sets (a positive Kubernetes quantity, e.g., 1Gi, or number of bytes; null to unset it); rendering fails if both are set

resources.description: Resource requests and limits of the container

enabled.description: Deploy a Celery worker with the app's image; requires broker.existingSecret

command.description: Command of the worker's container; required if enabled

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe of the worker's container; none if empty

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe of the worker's container; none if empty

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds that the worker gets to finish running tasks on shutdown

resources.description: Resource requests and limits of the container

enabled.description: Deploy RabbitMQ as the Celery broker (queued tasks are kept in a PersistentVolumeClaim, see persistence); requires existingSecret

existingSecret.description: Secret with the broker URL (key broker-url), optionally the result backend (result-backend) and, for the bundled broker, its user's credentials (username and password); passed to the app and the worker

image.description: RabbitMQ image, pinned to a patch version or digest

imagePullPolicy.description: Pull policy of the RabbitMQ image; Always if not set

enabled.description: Create a NetworkPolicy allowing connections to the broker only from the app's and the worker's pods

podSecurityContext.description: Security context of the pod (runAsUser, runAsGroup and fsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

securityContext.description: Security context of the container (runAsUser and runAsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

resources.description: Resource requests and limits of the container

enabled.description: Keep the broker's data (queued tasks) in a PersistentVolumeClaim; otherwise (also if not set) in an emptyDir, so that queued tasks are lost when its pod is replaced

resourcePolicy.description: keep: Helm keeps the broker's claim when the release is uninstalled; empty (also if not set): Helm deletes it, as queued tasks can be rebuilt

persistence.description: Volume with the broker's data (queued tasks)

dataSizeLimit.description: Size limit of the emptyDir with the broker's home and, without persistence, its data: a positive Kubernetes quantity (e.g., 1Gi) or number of bytes; none if null

extraEnv.description: Environment variables of the app's and the worker's containers (EnvVar), e.g., credentials from Secrets (valueFrom.secretKeyRef); not those set by the chart

enabled.description: Deploy Flower, the monitoring UI of the Celery worker; requires existingSecret and broker.existingSecret

existingSecret.description: Secret with the credentials of Flower's basic authentication (key basic-auth, <user>:<password>); required if enabled

image.description: Flower image, pinned to a version or digest

imagePullPolicy.description: Pull policy of the Flower image; Always if not set

enabled.description: Create a NetworkPolicy allowing connections to Flower only from ingressFrom

ingressFrom.description: NetworkPolicy peers allowed to connect to Flower; none if empty (kubectl port-forward is not affected)

podSecurityContext.description: Security context of the pod (runAsUser, runAsGroup and fsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

securityContext.description: Security context of the container (runAsUser and runAsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

resources.description: Resource requests and limits of the container
